rationale: MODEL-REPRESENTATION-DEPENDENT. The approved fold-safe model representation of gestational_age_at_PPROM_days (fold_safe_pprom_timing_categorical) has an explicit no_PPROM gate level (gate_col=PPROM, gate_value=1): rows with PPROM != 1 get 'no_PPROM'. With PPROM 0-missing this makes PPROM presence/absence deterministically encoded by the representation. The constraint applies to the MODEL REPRESENTATION, not to the raw continuous gestational_age_at_PPROM_days values (which are simply missing when PPROM == 0).
decision_source: Data Cleaning B Section B5b; outputs/data_cleaning/audit/cleaning_b_feature_dictionary.csv (PPROM row: 'no_PPROM already encodes PPROM==0/1 ... must never be SIMULTANEOUSLY selected together') + analysis/modeling/final_modeling/modeling_core.py _FOLD_SAFE_QUANTILE_SPECS['gestational_age_at_PPROM_days'] (gate_label='no_PPROM').
